heading: Solicitation of views of certain entities
lead: In carrying out this part, the Secretary, as appropriate, shall solicit the views of the States and other appropriate entities.
sourceCredit: (July 1, 1944, ch. 373, title XIX, § 1951, as added Pub. L. 102–321, title II, § 203(a), July 10, 1992, 106 Stat. 408.)
